crossRefs.note: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner, whom they desired.
Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whom they asked of him.
The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.
Now he had to release one prisoner to them at the feast.
Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,
Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”

translations.web: But you have a custom, that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
translations.bsb: But it is your custom that I release to you one prisoner at the Passover. So then, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
translations.kjv: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
translations.asv: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
